core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Foroud corresponds to the Persian form فروود (Persian فرود (Forūd)). Its core sense is fortune, prosperity. Foroud (فرود, Forūd) is a Persian male name; the source gloss 'fortune, prosperity' points to the Persian word فَرْوَد/فروود associated with auspiciousness, but the primary literary currency of فرود is as a hero's name in the Shahnameh (Forud, son of Siyavash). The source's 'Arabic form' فروود mixed a Japanese katakana character (ー) into the Arabic string, which has been corrected. Identification is probable, not certain.
